S06.title: The Short Trail. Eric Without Instructions

paragraphs.S06.C000.P000: The valley met them with steam, wet earth, and the smell of sulfur. The short trail was nearly empty. Eric walked ahead, but after a few minutes he stopped at a fork.
paragraphs.S06.C000.P003: “Both trails are safe. One is shorter; the other runs closer to the stream.”
paragraphs.S06.C000.P004: “Are you checking whether I read the map?”
paragraphs.S06.C000.P005: “I'm checking whether you want to choose.”
paragraphs.S06.C000.P006: Alice pointed to the longer trail.

S06.C001.title: If Alice asked Eric to explain the change in S05-C1

paragraphs.S06.C001.P000: Before they set off, he showed her the forecast on his screen again.
paragraphs.S06.C001.P001: “The wind has died down. The longer path is open, but we can turn back at any point.”
paragraphs.S06.C001.P002: “Then let's go,” Alice said. She saw that he remembered her question from that morning.

S06.C002.title: If Alice chose Nick or Damir in S05-C1

paragraphs.S06.C002.P000: Eric nodded, accepting her choice, and let her go first.

paragraphs.S06.C003.P000: Nick and Damir stayed behind: Nick was filming the steam above the ground, while Damir tied his shoe cover. Alice went first. A hundred meters later, the trail split again, and she slowed down.

S06.C004.title: If Alice rode with Eric in S01-C1

paragraphs.S06.C004.P000: Eric stopped beside her, but did not immediately point out the direction. She remembered asking him in the car to give her hints only when necessary, and checked the sign herself.

S06.C005.title: If Alice rode with Nick or Damir in S01-C1

paragraphs.S06.C005.P000: Eric waited while she studied the sign, then came closer.

paragraphs.S06.C006.P002: “There's a short exit to the stream. The trail doesn't continue past it.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P003: “What if I wanted to see what was there?”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P004: Eric thought about it and nodded.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P005: “If you want to, let's go right.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P006: The dead end turned out to be a platform above the stream. Nothing remarkable: wooden rails, wet stone, scraps of steam. Alice leaned her elbows on the railing.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P011: “Is that what you like in men?”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P012: The question was so unexpected that Alice turned. Eric was looking at the stream, but the corner of his mouth moved.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P013: “Sometimes,” she said. “Especially if they can survive it without a presentation.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P014: “I had a presentation. I left it in the car.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P015: They laughed. The wind blew a strand of Alice's hair across her face. She tried to move it with her glove and only smeared more rainwater across her cheek. Eric reached out, stopped a few centimeters away, and asked:
paragraphs.S06.C006.P017: Alice nodded. He moved the strand aside quickly, almost matter-of-factly, but his fingers brushed her temple for a moment. The warmth lasted longer than the touch.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P019: “If you've found a secret waterfall up there, I'm quitting!”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P020: “We found a dead end,” Alice called back.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P021: “Even better! It has an honest plot.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P022: On the way back, Eric told her how he had once led a group to a closed bridge because he had trusted an old map too much. The story was short and funny, with no lesson about leadership attached.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P024: “Told them it was a special lunch stop.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P028: “I was hoping to make a better impression.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P029: “Too late. Now you'll have to try for the next three weeks.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P032: An older couple caught up with them at the trailhead. The woman asked Eric in English how far it was to the hot river. Eric explained that the upper part of the route was closed because of the wind, showed them a short safe loop, and waited until they found it on the map.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P033: “You could have just told them not to go,” Alice remarked when the couple had left.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P034: “I could have. Then they would have decided I was being overcautious and gone to check.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P035: “And when you give them another option, they choose the sensible one themselves?”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P041: Nick finished filming the steam and joined them.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P042: “I heard everything. In the film, you'll be a devious Icelandic guide.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P044: “You offered,” Nick said, turning to Alice. “I've got a witness.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P045: Eric took off his glove and wiped a drop from his eyebrow.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P047: Nick fell silent for a second, then burst out laughing.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P049: At the trailhead, they took out the thermoses. Damir poured tea and accidentally handed Alice a cup without sugar, the way she used to drink it. She tasted it and grimaced.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P056: Damir nodded. He did not say that she had always hated sweet tea. He did not ask who had taught her to take it that way. He simply updated what he knew.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P057: Nick drank straight from the thermos lid.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P058: “I propose a road reform. Every day, we learn one useless thing about each other.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P060: “Useful things turn into obligations. Useless things turn into affection.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P063: “My useless thing,” Eric said. “I can't whistle.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P064: Nick immediately demanded proof. Eric tried; the result was a quiet sound like a tired kettle.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P065: Alice laughed into her sleeve. Eric watched her without offense, then tried again—worse.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P067: “I'm afraid of fish if I can't see the bottom.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P070: Nick admitted that he could not sleep without some kind of voice—a podcast, radio, or someone else's film. Damir thought for a long time and said he liked the smell of gasoline.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P073: “It's too early to judge the trip.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P074: On the path to the car, Alice walked beside Damir.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P075: “Do you really like the smell of gasoline?”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P076: “Since I was a child. My father repaired the car in the yard.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P079: They looked at each other. The conversation could have turned toward how much they had not known after living together for three years. Alice did not want that today.
paragraphs.S06.C006.P081: “I'm afraid he'll become unbearable if he finds out.”
paragraphs.S06.C006.P082: They agreed not to tell him.

S06.C007.title: Choice S06-C2 — What will Alice suggest to Eric while the others are still catching up?

S06.C008.title: A. Ask him to show her his favorite place on the trail

paragraphs.S06.C008.P000: “Just not the most famous one,” Alice said. Eric showed her a low outcrop overlooking the other side of the valley. They stood together counting birds until the group's voices rose behind them.

S06.C009.title: B. Ask him to choose the music for the drive back

paragraphs.S06.C009.P000: “Just no navigator's voice coming from the singer,” Alice warned. Eric laughed briefly and named a song his sister played every summer. Alice promised to listen to it in the car.
